cells.dispatch_order: levels descending in both stages: the wall question lives in the deep cells, so a wall-clock cutoff costs the shallow law anchors (k = 8, 16) and not the wall
cells.rule: first two gold-yes and first two gold-no in generation order with facts == 2*level exactly; 4 items per cell; constant baseline 0.50 per cell

stage2.candidate_rule: smallest-seed gold-yes item in the cell
stage2.rung_rule: floor(frac*L/64)*64 at frac in {0.8, 0.5}, L = the stage-1 natural stop; a truncated candidate is censored and unscored

flags: I1 fail -> early_commitment_observed (the wall is not a completeness wall)
I2 pass -> one_dispatch_predicts_rungs (budget ladder cost is 1 prompt per item)
any gold-no truncation -> wall_is_label_split, reported beside the tier

generator_ceiling.correction: the level-49 whole-series call is where the ceiling shows, but the same scan done item by item still yields load-floor items (C = 2, 2*(level+1) names) at 49, 50 and 64, so depth beyond 48 is reachable on the floor family; this round stays registered at 48
generator_ceiling.mechanism: an item draws C*(level+1) fresh synthetic names with the chain count C uniform in 2..level+2, and ladders._entity allows 100 rejection tries per name against a pool of 2700 names: the raise is a collision ceiling on item size, not a ceiling on depth

load_floor.note: facts >= 2k is a generator invariant, so a constant-prompt depth ladder cannot pass k = 32 (round 50's band ends there)

question: Where does the per-item output budget cross the 2048 cap on the ladder family at the generator's load floor (facts = 2k), and does a trace cut below its own measured natural stop still yield a verdict?
readout_policy: answer field only; the trace-recovery rules stay refused after round 50's calibration failure at 0.5652, so no claim in this round rests on a trace-derived verdict. Trace text is stored for prefix identity and length only.

rows.statement: the positive arm delivers at least 3 of 4 at the two deepest cells
no delivered record is wrong anywhere on the floor ladder
the negative arm delivers at most 3 of 6 at k >= 32 on the floor
the positive arm's natural stop grows with depth on the floor at 15 to 50 tokens per hop, against round 6's 80 and round 50's 31.3
mean natural stop of gold-no over gold-yes per cell, over uncensored records only; reportable when at least 3 of the cells 24, 32, 40, 48 carry at least one uncensored negative
cutting a delivered item below its own natural stop surfaces no verdict: at most 1 of 8 interrupt dispatches delivers

an interrupted output is the prefix of the same item's delivered output on at least 3 of 4 candidates (longest-common-prefix ratio >= 0.90 at both rungs), which is what a per-item budget ladder needs in order to need only one dispatch per item
the reasoning-supplying field is open on at least 90% of records
both in-firing duplicate re-dispatches are byte-identical
the k = 32 floor cell is round 50's archived M32 item set (digest pinned) and reproduces its per-item finish state on at least 3 of 4

tier_rule: F2 fail -> capability_bound_floor_depth (a delivered answer is wrong: an accuracy ceiling is placed)
F1 fail -> wall_reaches_both_arms (the positive arm no longer delivers: the cap binds on the traversal at every label)
F1 pass and F3 pass -> label_split_wall (positives deliver, negatives die)
F1 pass and F3 fail -> no_wall_inside_generator_ceiling (nothing dies to k = 48)
